header_notes: work/cGameModeArena.h: CD2 size 0x10C. Base is 0x60 bytes: CAttributeHandler + a polymorphic second base at 0x18 (14 virtuals, virtual dtor first, short handle at 0x1C, 0x48 bytes) modelled by stand-ins cGMMEventBase and cGMMResource (out-of-line ctor/dtor/HandleAttributes). Members from 0x60: list (alloc slot, head, size), vectors solo 0x6C, team[2] 0x7C, pickup[2] 0x9C, weapon 0xBC, launch pads 0xCC, barrier 0xDC, unknown 0xE0, camera container 0xE4, string id 0xE8, ToD phase/period 0xEC/0xF0, bools 0xF4/F5, weather mode 0xF8, force weather 0xFC, three extra words 0x100-0x108 versus RuffKing (0x100 value, 0x104/0x108 = -1). 22-slot primary vtable verified with /d1reportSingleClassLayout. Stand-ins named by us: cList, cVec, cRandGen, cLocStringManager hash chain, cEventId, cMsg, cString, cArenaEntity. Suggest adding to shared headers: RWS::CEventHandler with 14 virtuals as the CD2 second base of GMM resources, an MSVC-2008 style cString (inline dtor, c_str as res>=16 ? ptr : buf), cEventId/CMsg/SendMsg, cRandGen, and vector erase/clear with memmove_s.
